name: canvas
description:
Save and read rich content from Jarvis Canvas - a visual viewer for research results, code snippets, comparisons, media, and reference material.

IMPORTANT: For research tasks, create canvas as your FINAL step AFTER gathering ALL data. To ADD new material to an existing page, use action='append' with page_id and only the new Markdown; Canvas preserves the existing page server-side. Use action='update' only for an intentional full-page rewrite and pass the complete replacement content. When the source result includes media, preserve its complete URL or stash:// reference in content. Canvas automatically embeds supported YouTube videos and direct or stashed video files without tool-specific markup.

Use when:
- User asks to research something and results are complex
- User asks to 'save to canvas' or 'put in viewer'
- User asks to add a new section, source, video, or finding to an existing Canvas page → append
- Content has tables, code, media, or detailed formatting
- User asks 'what's on my canvas?' or 'read my canvas page about X'
- User wants to summarize/read a specific canvas page

Finding pages:
- 'summarize the 69x Opportunity page' → action=read, search='69x Opportunity'
- 'read my notes from yesterday' → action=read, search='Notes/2026-01'
- 'what research do I have?' → action=read, search='Workflows/Research'
- 'show all canvas pages' → action=list

Actions: create (new page), append (add content while preserving the page), update (intentional full replacement), delete (remove), list (show all), open (get URL), read (find and get page content by search term or page_id).

action.description: Action to perform. create=new page; append=add new Markdown to an existing page without resending old content; update=replace the full existing content; delete=remove; list=show all; open=get URL; read=get page content

title.description: Page title (required for create, optional for update)

content.description: Markdown content. REQUIRED for create/append/update. For append, pass ONLY the new section; existing content is preserved server-side and no line numbers are needed. For update, pass the FULL replacement page. Supports headers, lists, tables, code blocks, images, and video. Preserve complete direct media URLs and stash:// references from source tool results; Canvas detects video by media metadata rather than tool name. If you include sources/links, URLs must be complete and resolvable. NEVER use shortened/truncated links like 'https://...'.

image_url.description: Optional image URL or stash ref to embed at the top of the canvas page. Use this whenever a tool result already includes a thumbnail, product image, or other image the user wants preserved on the page.

image_alt.description: Optional alt text/caption for the embedded image. Example: 'Amazon product image' or 'Generated concept art'.

tags.description: Tags for categorization. Examples: research, code, reference, movies, servers

source_query.description: The original user query that led to this content (for reference)

page_id.description: Page ID for update/delete/read actions. Format: page_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS

search.description: Search term to find pages by title or content (for read action). Searches folder paths too. Examples: '69x Opportunity', 'Workflows/Deep Dive', 'Notes/', 'bitcoin price'.

pinned.description: Pin page to top of list

allow_content_shrink.description: For update only. Set true only when the user intends to replace a large existing page with substantially less content. Never use this to add material; use append instead.

limit.description: Max pages to return for list action (default 10)
